doc.notes: Element masking via `mask_offset` and `mask_shift` fills elements whose derived mask bit is **0** (deactivated) in `MULT_RES` with the DS `mask_type` value (0, +inf or −inf) before accumulation; elements with bit **1** pass through. See [Masking](assembly-syntax.md#masking) for the full algorithm.
operands: `ra_idx`: **`LR0`**…**`LR15`** — index of the single Ra element to read (combined `R0` ++ `R1`, 256 elements, mod 256).

`cr_idx`: **`CR0`**…**`CR15`** — the scalar: a MULT constant (NX8: `value[7:0]`, `scale[15:8]`, `fe[19:16]`, `sign[23:20]`, decoded with its own scale; FP32: float32 bits). CR0 reads as 0.0 and CR1 as 1.0 in both modes (see `CrIdx` and [CR scalars](../../explanation/element-formats.md#cr-scalars)).
`mask_offset`: immediate mask slot **`0`**…**`7`** — selects one of eight 128-bit masks in **`R_MASK`**.

`mask_shift`: **`LR0`**…**`LR15`** — index ∈ [−3, +3] (values >3 clamp to 3, values <−3 clamp to −3) selecting one of seven masks via sequential shift-and-AND: positive indices use partition_vector (0 at group start), negative indices use inverse_partition_vector (0 at group end).

`ds`: **`CR0.L`**…**`CR15.H`** — DS half-CR (`ipu_isa.cr_halves`): `num_partitions` builds the partition vectors for `mask_shift`, `mask_type` is the value written into deactivated elements (0, +inf or −inf; NaN is an emulator error). The whole DS is validated.

`qf`: **`CR0.L`**…**`CR15.H`** — QF half-CR naming the NX8 format of the vector elements: in NX8 mode each element expands to FP32 with its row's metadata (`ARCH-stage-mult.md` §3.2.1); ignored in FP32 mode.
doc.operation: ra = expand(Ra[ra_idx % 256]); result = ra * constant(CR[cr_idx]); for each element i: MULT_RES[i] = result; then apply mask and shift using DS[ds].num_partitions and DS[ds].mask_type.
doc.summary: Multiply a single Ra element by a CR constant; broadcast the product to all 128 elements. The partition used by mask_shift and the mask pad come from the DS half `ds`; in NX8 mode the Ra element is decoded with the QF half `qf`.
doc.syntax: MULT.EE ra_idx cr_idx mask_offset mask_shift ds qf
doc.title: Ra Element × CR Scalar Multiply (broadcast)

`mask_shift`: **`LR0`**…**`LR15`** — index ∈ [−3, +3] (values >3 clamp to 3, values <−3 clamp to −3) selecting one of seven masks via sequential shift-and-AND: positive indices use partition_vector (0 at group start), negative indices use inverse_partition_vector (0 at group end).

`ds`: **`CR0.L`**…**`CR15.H`** — DS half-CR (`ipu_isa.cr_halves`): `num_partitions` builds the partition vectors for `mask_shift`, `mask_type` is the value written into deactivated elements (0, +inf or −inf; NaN is an emulator error). The whole DS is validated.

`qf`: **`CR0.L`**…**`CR15.H`** — QF half-CR naming the NX8 format of the vector elements: in NX8 mode each element expands to FP32 with its row's metadata (`ARCH-stage-mult.md` §3.2.1); ignored in FP32 mode.
doc.operation: For each element i: rb = expand(R_CYCLIC[(rc_idx + i) % 512]); MULT_RES[i] = rb * rb; then apply mask and shift using DS[ds].num_partitions and DS[ds].mask_type.
doc.summary: Square R_CYCLIC[rc_idx:rc_idx+128] element-wise. The partition used by mask_shift and the mask pad come from the DS half `ds`; in NX8 mode the elements are decoded with the QF half `qf`.
doc.syntax: MULT.RC.VS rc_idx mask_offset mask_shift ds qf
doc.title: RC Vector Self-Multiply (Square)

doc.example: MULT.RC.VV LR0 R0 0 LR2 CR15.L CR14.L;;
doc.notes: Element masking via `mask_offset` and `mask_shift` fills elements whose derived mask bit is **0** (deactivated) in `MULT_RES` with the DS `mask_type` value (0, +inf or −inf) before accumulation; elements with bit **1** pass through. See [Masking](assembly-syntax.md#masking) for the full algorithm.
operands: `rc_idx`: **`LR0`**…**`LR15`** — base ELEMENT index into **`R_CYCLIC`** (cyclic, mod 512 elements; same unit as `LD.MULT.CYCLIC`'s `index`).
`ra`: **`R0`** | **`R1`** — multiplicand mult-stage register (same cycle as `LD.MULT` into **`R0`**/**`R1`** is allowed).
`mask_offset`: immediate mask slot **`0`**…**`7`** — selects one of eight 128-bit masks in **`R_MASK`**.

`mask_shift`: **`LR0`**…**`LR15`** — index ∈ [−3, +3] (values >3 clamp to 3, values <−3 clamp to −3) selecting one of seven masks via sequential shift-and-AND: positive indices use partition_vector (0 at group start), negative indices use inverse_partition_vector (0 at group end).

`ds`: **`CR0.L`**…**`CR15.H`** — DS half-CR (`ipu_isa.cr_halves`): `num_partitions` builds the partition vectors for `mask_shift`, `mask_type` is the value written into deactivated elements (0, +inf or −inf; NaN is an emulator error). The whole DS is validated.

`qf`: **`CR0.L`**…**`CR15.H`** — QF half-CR naming the NX8 format of the vector elements: in NX8 mode each element expands to FP32 with its row's metadata (`ARCH-stage-mult.md` §3.2.1); ignored in FP32 mode.
doc.operation: For each element i: MULT_RES[i] = expand(R_CYCLIC[(rc_idx + i) % 512]) * expand(ra[i]); then apply mask and shift using DS[ds].num_partitions and DS[ds].mask_type.
doc.summary: Multiply R_CYCLIC[rc_idx:rc_idx+128] by Ra (R0 or R1) element-wise. The partition used by mask_shift and the mask pad come from the DS half `ds`; in NX8 mode the elements are decoded with the QF half `qf` and their rows' metadata.
doc.syntax: MULT.RC.VV rc_idx ra mask_offset mask_shift ds qf
doc.title: RC Vector × Ra Vector Multiply

doc.example: MULT.VE LR0 CR3 0 LR2 CR15.L CR14.L;;
doc.notes: Element masking via `mask_offset` and `mask_shift` fills elements whose derived mask bit is **0** (deactivated) in `MULT_RES` with the DS `mask_type` value (0, +inf or −inf) before accumulation; elements with bit **1** pass through. See [Masking](assembly-syntax.md#masking) for the full algorithm.
operands: `ra_idx`: **`LR0`**…**`LR15`** — base element offset into combined Ra (`R0` ++ `R1`, 256 elements, cyclic mod 256).

`cr_idx`: **`CR0`**…**`CR15`** — the scalar: a MULT constant (NX8: `value[7:0]`, `scale[15:8]`, `fe[19:16]`, `sign[23:20]`, decoded with its own scale; FP32: float32 bits). CR0 reads as 0.0 and CR1 as 1.0 in both modes (see `CrIdx` and [CR scalars](../../explanation/element-formats.md#cr-scalars)).
`mask_offset`: immediate mask slot **`0`**…**`7`** — selects one of eight 128-bit masks in **`R_MASK`**.

`mask_shift`: **`LR0`**…**`LR15`** — index ∈ [−3, +3] (values >3 clamp to 3, values <−3 clamp to −3) selecting one of seven masks via sequential shift-and-AND: positive indices use partition_vector (0 at group start), negative indices use inverse_partition_vector (0 at group end).

`ds`: **`CR0.L`**…**`CR15.H`** — DS half-CR (`ipu_isa.cr_halves`): `num_partitions` builds the partition vectors for `mask_shift`, `mask_type` is the value written into deactivated elements (0, +inf or −inf; NaN is an emulator error). The whole DS is validated.

`qf`: **`CR0.L`**…**`CR15.H`** — QF half-CR naming the NX8 format of the vector elements: in NX8 mode each element expands to FP32 with its row's metadata (`ARCH-stage-mult.md` §3.2.1); ignored in FP32 mode.
doc.operation: For each element i: ra = expand(Ra[(ra_idx + i) % 256]); MULT_RES[i] = ra * constant(CR[cr_idx]); then apply mask and shift using DS[ds].num_partitions and DS[ds].mask_type.
doc.summary: Multiply Ra[ra_idx:ra_idx+128] (combined R0/R1) by a CR constant, element-wise. The partition used by mask_shift and the mask pad come from the DS half `ds`; in NX8 mode the Ra elements are decoded with the QF half `qf`.
doc.syntax: MULT.VE ra_idx cr_idx mask_offset mask_shift ds qf
doc.title: Ra Vector × CR Scalar Multiply

AaqActivationFn.description: AAQ-slot keyword on **`ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE`**: **identity** (0), **relu** (1), **relu6** (2), **reciprocal** (3), **rsqrt** (4), **exp2** (5), **generic** (6), as `ARCH-stage-aaq-str.md` encodes them (code 7 is reserved). **generic** evaluates the LUT loaded with `LD.LUT`; the emulator computes the function a test declares as loaded (ADR 0007).

ActivationFn.description: Keyword on the emulator-only **`ACTIVATE.EXACT`**: one of **identity**, **relu**, **relu6**, **sigmoid**, **tanh**, **gelu**, **softplus**, **elu**, **exp2**, **reciprocal**, **rsqrt**, **silu**, **window** (see ``ACTIVATION_FN_NAMES`` in ``ipu_isa.activations``). Emulator-only calibration (including α and the **window** bounds a, b) is described in **`ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE` in the emulator** (`docs/content/reference/isa/activate-quantize.md`).

AddbiImmediate.description: 8-bit byte immediate for **`ADDBI`**: written as an unsigned value **`0`**–**`255`** or an equivalent signed **`-128`**–**`127`** literal (both spellings encode the same bit pattern). The encoded byte is reinterpreted as a signed two's-complement `int8` when broadcast-added to **`ADDB`**/**`ADDBI`**'s 8 destination byte elements.

CrIdx.description:
Constant-register index: **`CR0`** … **`CR15`**. CRs are **read-only** in assembly; the harness initializes them (e.g. base pointers, strides, QF and DS halves). **`SET`** in the LR slot copies the full **32-bit** CR value (or a sign-extended half) into an LR.

**CR as an element scalar.** When a CR is a multiply's scalar element operand (**`MULT.VE`**, **`MULT.EE`**, a CR **`src`** of **`MULT.RC.VE`**), NX8 mode decodes it with the MULT constant layout (`value[7:0]`, `scale[15:8]`, `fe[19:16]`, `sign[23:20]`; `ipu_isa.cr_halves`) and FP32 mode reads it as IEEE float32 bits. **`CR0`** reads as 0.0 and **`CR1`** as 1.0 in both modes, so a multiply by **`CR1`** is an identity; as an LR or integer operand **`CR1`** is the integer 1.

ElementsInRow.description: ACC-slot immediate: elements per row for **`ACC.STRIDE`**. Valid values: **`16`**, **`32`**, **`64`** (minimum is 16; encoded 0→16, 1→32, 2→64). See `acc_stride_enums` in `ipu_isa`.

HalfCrIdx.description: Half-CR selector: **`CR0.L`**, **`CR0.H`**, … **`CR15.H`** (code = 2 × index + H). `.L` is bits 15:0 of the CR, `.H` bits 31:16. Used for the **`ds`** (data structure) and **`qf`** (quantization format) operands of the MULT, AGG and AaQ instructions; their 16-bit layouts are in `ipu_isa.cr_halves` (ADR 0007). A bare **`CR13`** is not accepted here: the operand always names a half. **`CR15.L`** holds the default DS at reset.

HorizontalStride.description: ACC-slot immediate: horizontal stride mode for **`ACC.STRIDE`**. Valid values: **`off`**, **`on`**, **`on_inv`** (2-bit encoded enum; **`reserved3`** is reserved). Expand padding is fixed hardware behaviour and is not programmable. See `acc_stride_enums` in `ipu_isa`.

Label.description: Branch target: a symbolic **`label`** or a relative offset accepted by the cond slot (e.g. `loop`, `+3`).

LcrHalfIdx.description: LR, CR or CR-half index in one 6-bit field: codes 0–15 are **`LR0`–`LR15`**, 16–31 **`CR0`–`CR15`**, 32–47 **`CR0.L`–`CR15.L`** and 48–63 **`CR0.H`–`CR15.H`**. A half is read as its 16 bits sign-extended to 32. The scalar source of the LR instructions (**`SET`** `src`, **`ADD`**/**`SUB`**/**`ADDB`** `src_b`, **`INC.MODP2`** `step`) and the compared registers of the COND branches.

LcrIdx.description: LR **or** CR index in one field: lower indices map to **`LR0`–`LR15`**, higher indices to **`CR0`–`CR15`** in the usual combined ordering used by the assembler. Used as **`src`** on **`MULT.RC.VE`** (an LR's stored value selects an element from `R0`/`R1`; a CR is the scalar directly, decoded as in [CrIdx](#cridx)).

LrIdx.description: Loop register index: resolves to **`LR0`** … **`LR15`**. Often used for addresses, strides, and control values. When marked `read: live` in the spec, the emulator reads the **current** LR value after earlier slots in the same cycle.

LrIncDecImmediate.description: Unsigned immediate for **`INC`** / **`DEC`** in the LR slot. The bit width **W** is not hardcoded — it is derived from the LR slot union layout so the total slot width stays constant. Valid range: **`0`** to **`2^W − 1`**.

LrModPow2KImmediate.description: Four-bit immediate for **`INC.MODP2`**: encodes exponent **k** with semantic **k ∈ [1, 9]** as **(k − 1)** in the word.

LrOrReshapeMaskImmediate.description: Operand on **`ACC.RESHAPE`** (bit width auto-derived from union layout): selects the first participating element slot (elements **`reshape_mask`**…**`7`** of the source/dest LRD pair participate). Accepts either an unsigned immediate **`0`**–**`7`** or an LR register (its value is used directly as the mask; a resolved value greater than **`8`** raises an error rather than being clamped). **`0`** uses all 8 slots; **`7`** uses only slot 7; **`8`** uses none.

LrdIdx.description: Register-pair index: **`LRD0`**, **`LRD2`**, **`LRD4`**, … **`LRD14`** — named after the lower register in the pair — each aliasing two adjacent **`LR`** registers as one 8-byte-element value: **`LRDn`** = **`LR(n+1)`** (high elements) concatenated with **`LR(n)`** (low elements). Purely an assembler/emulator view; there is no separate physical storage. Used as **`dest`** on **`ADDB`** / **`ADDBI`**.

LutAddrImmediate.description: Three-bit immediate on **`LD.LUT`**: which of the five 1024-bit LUT segments the load fills (**`0`**–**`4`**; codes 5–7 are reserved).

MultMaskOffsetImmediate.description: Unsigned **3-bit** immediate on multiply instructions: **`mask_offset`** selects slot **`0`**–**`7`**, each a **128-bit** region of **`R_MASK`** (eight mask slots total). **`mask_shift`** remains an **`LrIdx`**.

MultStageReg.description: Multiply-stage field in the VLIW encoding. Assembly accepts **`R0`** and **`R1`** only; the field is **two bits** wide (encoding `2` is reserved). Used as the destination of `LD.MULT` and as the **`ra`** operand of `MULT.RC.VV`.

VerticalStride.description: ACC-slot immediate: **vertical stride** bit pattern for `ACC.STRIDE` (see `acc_stride_enums`).

lrd0.about: LRD0, LRD2, LRD4, ..., LRD14: register-pair alias over LR, named after the lower register in the pair (LRDn = LR(n+1):LR(n), n even).

lrd10.about: LRD0, LRD2, LRD4, ..., LRD14: register-pair alias over LR, named after the lower register in the pair (LRDn = LR(n+1):LR(n), n even).

lrd12.about: LRD0, LRD2, LRD4, ..., LRD14: register-pair alias over LR, named after the lower register in the pair (LRDn = LR(n+1):LR(n), n even).

lrd14.about: LRD0, LRD2, LRD4, ..., LRD14: register-pair alias over LR, named after the lower register in the pair (LRDn = LR(n+1):LR(n), n even).

lrd2.about: LRD0, LRD2, LRD4, ..., LRD14: register-pair alias over LR, named after the lower register in the pair (LRDn = LR(n+1):LR(n), n even).

lrd4.about: LRD0, LRD2, LRD4, ..., LRD14: register-pair alias over LR, named after the lower register in the pair (LRDn = LR(n+1):LR(n), n even).

lrd6.about: LRD0, LRD2, LRD4, ..., LRD14: register-pair alias over LR, named after the lower register in the pair (LRDn = LR(n+1):LR(n), n even).

lrd8.about: LRD0, LRD2, LRD4, ..., LRD14: register-pair alias over LR, named after the lower register in the pair (LRDn = LR(n+1):LR(n), n even).

aaq.description: Activation and quantization: activate R_ACC, quantize to one NX8 row and store it with its metadata; load the LUT segments the generic activation reads.

aaq_exact.description: Emulator-only exact activation: activate R_ACC with the exact Python function and store one FP32 row (FP32 mode only). Not in the hardware word.

acc.description: Accumulation instructions for combining multiply results into R_ACC.

break.description: Debug break: halts execution or enters debug mode.

cond.description: Conditional and unconditional branches; control flow based on register comparisons.

load.description: First-stage memory loads that feed the multiply unit (mult-stage, cyclic, and mask registers).

lr.description: Loop register instructions for controlling addresses, counters, and scalars. Three independent sub-slots per cycle.

mult.description: Multiply-stage instructions: element-wise and vector multiply operations.
